method: AI web verification (owner ruling: AI-sourced URL+date suffices for entry; human-review gate retired). Terrain, shooting points, subject orientation and opening windows verified per spot before contract authoring.
scope: CL-DATA-20: seven no-contract spots (tw-006, tw-007, tw-029, tw-039, tw-058, tw-083, tw-084) + tidal genre marking (tw-059-P01, tw-078-P01) + tw-016-P01 summit geometry.

evidence.supports: Guandu Bridge: red welded steel arches, 809 m across the Tamsui River; left-bank and right-bank viewing towers named as the best vantage points; sunset-gilded arches from the left-bank tower and night illumination/vehicle light trails; footpaths 2.25 m each side. Page updated 2024-08-30.
evidence.limitation: Tourism copy, not an engineering survey; exact camera coordinates not given

evidence.supports: Guandu Bridge coordinates 25.12556N 121.45722E (matches V1 point within ~50 m); completed 1983-10-31; five-span continuous steel-tied arch across the Tamsui River, ~6 km from the estuary.
evidence.limitation: Community encyclopedia; coordinates cross-checked against V1 POI

evidence.supports: Bitan suspension bridge light-projection show: dynamic colour lighting on the bridge side with the New Taipei City Government citing the riverside reflections of the gorge; evening show slots 18:00-22:00 hourly (2022 season; current schedule follows on-site notices).
evidence.limitation: 2022 press release; show hours change by season/announcement

evidence.supports: Bitan scenery: suspension bridge completed 1937 spanning the Xindian River; wide calm pool giving water reflections; Hebishan trail and east-bank plaza vantage points; evening illumination and water-side views.
evidence.limitation: Personal travel blog; used only for vantage/terrain corroboration

evidence.supports: Eluanbi Lighthouse: coordinates 21.90222N 120.85278E; tower height 21.4 m, light centre 56.4 m above high water; white cast-iron tower built 1883, rebuilt 1898; park hours 09:00-18:00 summer (4/1-10/31) and 09:00-17:00 winter, closed Mondays; southernmost lighthouse on Taiwan's main island facing the Pacific.
evidence.limitation: Community encyclopedia; hours match lighthouse administration data cited there

evidence.supports: Eluanbi area: the southernmost-point sea-view platform faces east over the Pacific and is a sunrise vantage; the park holds the white lighthouse with coral-reef grassland scenery; sunrise at the southernmost point is a common itinerary item.
evidence.limitation: Travel aggregator copy; used for vantage orientation, not for times or coordinates

evidence.supports: Mr. Brown Avenue (Jinxin No.3 Road), Chishang: ~2.2 km straight lane with no utility poles; elevation 262-286 m; motor vehicles banned year-round; golden rice waves typically late May-June and late October-December, most golden 1-2 weeks before harvest; soft morning light before the sun clears the Coastal Range. Content marked Taiwan Tourism Administration CC BY 4.0.
evidence.limitation: Third-party site carrying official content; harvest timing varies yearly with weather

evidence.supports: Chishang rice calendar: first crop turns golden in June, second crop golden in October-November; paddy mirror reflections at transplanting; morning light named the most attractive shooting time.

Penghu Great Bridge: connects Baisha and Xiyu across the Houmen channel, bridge length 2,494 m after the 1985-1996 rebuild, with walkways on both sides; wide sea views - sunrise in the morning and evening glow at dusk. Text cited from Taiwan Place-Name Gazetteer Vol. 6 (Penghu County).
evidence.limitation: Historical gazetteer text; current traffic rules follow road authority

evidence.supports: Sunset over the Taiwan Strait beside the bridge around dusk is named a signature moment; bridge is Taiwan's longest sea-crossing bridge (2,494 m).

Yunshan Shui (Shoufeng, Hualien): Dream Lake approx. 4 ha with lakeside bald cypress water forest; opening hours 08:00-17:00 posted by the estate (other sources advertise round-the-clock; current status follows on-site notices); calm mornings give the clearest lake reflections with the Central Range behind.
evidence.limitation: Private estate; hours/fees change; personal blog used because the estate has no official site

evidence.supports: Danongdafu Flatland Forest Park (East Rift Valley National Scenic Area Administration): visitor center 08:00-17:00, closed Mondays (except summer/winter vacation and national holidays); north and south loop bikeways; firefly season March-April; maple season December-January; spring flower sea in front of the visitor center. Page updated 2024-03-28.
evidence.limitation: Official tourism page; seasonal colour timing varies year to year

evidence.supports: Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency trail/park page: 1,250 ha flatland forest between the Central and Coastal ranges; north-loop goldenrain tree flowers then pink capsules in late summer-autumn; south-loop Elaeocarpus/sweet gum/maple colour in winter; ~13 km in-forest bikeways; free entry.
evidence.limitation: Species colouring timing varies with the year
